ai_summary: Alphageo (India) Limited (AGIL) announced that Alphageo Offshore Services Private Limited (AOSPL) ceased to be its subsidiary as of September 18, 2026. This significant change occurred because AGIL renounced its entitlement in an AOSPL Rights Issue, diluting its shareholding below 51% and resulting in a loss of control over the offshore entity. The material impact is that AOSPL's financials will no longer be consolidated with AGIL's; this voluntary relinquishment of control raises a red flag regarding AGIL's financial capacity or a strategic shift away from its offshore operations.
